What we offer

One supplier for every tape on the job.

Most sites buy tape from four different places and still end up short. We hold the whole range in one catalogue — from everyday masking tape to structural acrylic foam bonding — so a single purchase order covers the lot.

My Tape Store supplies adhesive tapes, fasteners and dispensing equipment across Australia. The range spans everyday consumables and specification-grade industrial products, held in stock and dispatched from Victoria to every state.

We sell to builders and fabricators, to schools and councils, to signwriters, boatbuilders, electricians and manufacturers. The products differ enormously; what does not change is that the right tape, chosen once, is cheaper than the wrong tape bought three times.

If you are unsure which product suits an application, tell us the substrates, the temperature range and whether the bond needs to be permanent. We will recommend from the range rather than sell you the most expensive option.

Pricing scales with quantity. For volumes beyond the published breaks, standing orders, or supply against a purchase order, contact us for a written quotation.

Fast delivery across Australia

Dispatched from Victoria to 3,600+ postcodes, with standard and express options and same-day dispatch on stocked lines ordered before cut-off.

Bulk orders and volume pricing

Unit prices step down automatically with quantity across most of the range. Beyond the published breaks, tell us the volume and we will quote it.

Priority support

Talk to someone who uses the products. Specification help, substrate advice and order tracking by phone or email — not a ticket queue.

Australian owned and operated

An Australian business holding Australian stock. No offshore drop-ship, no six-week lead times, and an ABN for your supplier onboarding.

Purchase orders accepted

Schools, councils, universities and government departments can order against a PO. Written quotations issued for procurement and tender.

Cut and custom sizes

Many products can be slit to width or cut to length for a specific job. Ask when you request a quotation.

Lowest-price guarantee

Found the same product cheaper elsewhere in Australia? Tell us and we will match it. You should not have to shop around to buy tape.

30-day returns

Unopened stock can be returned within 30 days. If we specify the wrong product for your application, we will make it right.

Ordering

Tell us the quantity. We'll quote it.

There is no price list in this catalogue on purpose. A school buying six rolls and a fabricator buying six cartons should not pay the same rate, and a published price serves neither.

To request a quotation, send the product names and the quantities you expect to use — per order or per year, whichever you know. If you are not certain which product suits the job, describe the application instead and we will specify it.

For procurement and tenders, we can supply written quotations, specification data and ABN details for supplier onboarding. Purchase orders are accepted from schools, councils, universities and government departments.

Request a quote

Send us the products and quantities, or describe the application and we will specify it for you.
